author: C. L. Conroy
title: White students accounted for 58% of Northgate High's enrollment in 2024-25 - NC Georgia News
text:
Reports from the Georgia Department of Education indicate Northgate High School had 1,213 white students enrolled in the 2024-25 school year, marking a 1% increase from the prior year.
Overall, Northgate High School reported a total enrollment of 2,093 students for the 2024-25 school year. White students composed 58% of the student body, the largest demographic at the school.
The school is part of the Coweta County School District and is based in Newnan.
East Coweta High School, among the 29 schools in the Coweta County School District, saw the highest number of white students enrolled in the 2024-25 school year at 1,342.
According to the National Center for Education Statistics, Georgia’s public school student demographics were about 36.4% Black, 35.9% white, 18.1% Hispanic, 4% Asian, 4.6% multiracial, 0.2% American Indian or Alaska Native, and 0.1% Pacific Islander.
Post-pandemic, chronic absenteeism remains a significant challenge in Georgia schools, with 20.7% of students missing at least 10% of school days in 2024, the Georgia Department of Education reports. To address this, GaDOE launched a statewide initiative featuring a real-time attendance dashboard, a public awareness campaign, and targeted support for districts with higher needs to increase daily attendance.
In 2025, Georgia lawmakers approved legislation amending school attendance laws to prohibit expulsion solely on the basis of absenteeism. The measure also introduces expanded reporting requirements and aligns with programs offering alternative diploma pathways for students.
For 2026, Georgia’s average student-to-teacher ratio was approximately 14:1, which is lower than the national average of 15:1.
